body:
Revised in round 4. zmux keeps no state and knows nothing of Emacs, ghostty, umbriel or systemd. The model is `zmx ls` plus labels; the only writes are labels and new sessions.

Three jobs: (1) name and label a session at birth — mechanism in d-birth, and the only reason creation is zmux's business at all is d-naming; (2) read that model back in a form humans and programs both parse — d-output; (3) leave every other surface to composition — d-surfaces.

What is not yet agreed: the label vocabulary (q-labels), whether a picker ships and in what language (q-language), how much of the shared world is exposed (q-coordination), and the exact first cut (q-v0).
title: Shape: a stateless reader plus one creation path
